content.short: 4EVERLAND is a Web3 cloud computing platform that helps developers and project hosts store and serve apps, files and data.
content.description: 4EVERLAND is a Web3 cloud computing platform that enables developers and project hosts to publish and manage websites, NFTs, files, and data using IPFS, Arweave, and Dfinity. Developers can quickly deploy frontends to IPFS, Arweave, or Dfinity and handle files through an S3-style interface provided by 4EVERLAND. A global acceleration gateway is available to boost access performance for hosted content, enhancing delivery speed and reliability for websites and assets across distributed networks.
content.meta: 4EVERLAND is a Web3 cloud platform for hosting apps, files and data on IPFS, Arweave, Dfinity. Discover 4EVERLAND and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
